text: Core courses Math Analysis, Advanced Algebra, Analytic Geometry, Ordinary Differential Equation, Complex Analysis, Modern Algebra, Operations Research, Statistics and Probability, Basic Theoretical Computer Science, Numerical Computation Methods, C Programming Language, Data Structure, Fundamentals of Software System, Foundations of Information Science, Computer Graphics, Basic Sociology. Objective This objective is to train students to obtain solid math knowledge, and the basic theories and methods of information and computation so that students, after graduation, will become high-qualified professional personnel who can operate computer and other modern facilities for scientific computation, applied software development, system maintenance, and information analysis and control as well as being engaged in scientific planning and management in technology sectors. Students after graduation can continue to study math or related specialties at graduate level or work in science and technology units, education sections, enterprises or institutions to pursuit research, teaching, application development or management in respect of information science and computation. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Science is granted.
